decision: Drop of 10 grid positions for the next Race in which the driver participates.
fact: The following Power Unit elements have been used: 9th Energy Store (ES) 8th Control Electronics Unit (PU-CE)
offence: Breaches of Articles B8.2.2 d) and e) (read with B8.2.3) of the FIA F1 Regulations.
penalty: Drop of 10 grid positions for the next Race in which the driver participates.
reason: The penalty is imposed in accordance with Article B8.2.8b of the FIA F1 Regulations. The use of each additional element in this case carries a 5 grid place penalty therefore there is an accumulation of 10 places.
stewards: in accordance with Article 15 of the FIA International Sporting Code
are based solely on the relevant regulations
